title: Email codes: enable, choose and turn off
summary: Enable optional email verification, choose the method offered first, and keep your authenticator available.
scenes: Check whether email codes are available
Use either method and turn email off

steps.say: First sign in with your password and authenticator. Open Sign-in methods from the header.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Your agency decides whether email codes are allowed. They need an email address on your account and are never available to administrators.
onScreen: Email codes · OFF · Email codes are less secure than your authenticator app: anyone who can read your email could use them. NIST SP 800-63B-4 does not accept email as an out-of-band authenticator. Your agency allows them as an extra option; your authenticator app stays on either way. · To turn them on, enter a current code from your authenticator app. We will then send a code to l***@merit.example

steps.say: Read the warning before enabling email codes. Anyone who can read your email could use them. Your authenticator stays required and available.
onScreen: Email codes are less secure than your authenticator app: anyone who can read your email could use them. NIST SP 800-63B-4 does not accept email as an out-of-band authenticator. Your agency allows them as an extra option; your authenticator app stays on either way.

steps.say: Enter a current authenticator code to start. Confirm that the masked address is yours; ask your administrator to correct it if needed.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Read the newest email, enter its verification code, and choose Confirm and turn on email codes. This proves access to the address.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)
Selects “Confirm and turn on email codes”

steps.say: Under At sign-in, offer first, choose An email code and save your choice. This changes the first option, not the need for a second factor.
Sign out and enter your password again. Get a code by email is now offered first, while your authenticator remains an alternative.
onScreen: Enter your verification code · Get a code by email · We'll send a six-digit code to l***@merit.example. It works once, for 5 minutes. · Email me a code · Or enter a code from your authenticator app · Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · Six-digit code from your authenticator app * · Or enter one of your ten-character recovery codes. · Verify and sign in · Can't access your authentica

steps.say: Choose Email me a code. Enter the code from the newest email, then Verify and sign in. Codes work once and expire after the time shown.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from the email (hidden)

steps.say: To prefer your authenticator again, open Sign-in methods, choose My authenticator app, and save your choice.
Turn off email codes removes that option. Your authenticator still works. Sign in once more to check that the email option is gone.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
